title: Expected bit predicate
statement: Given a machine action and a Boolean assignment to the ports, an expectation holds as follows: a copy expectation reads the old-bit port; a constant expectation returns its specified Boolean value; and a summary expectation reads the current summary flags, encodes the resulting summary as a word, appends the action's optional output symbol if present, and returns whether the summary of that word is dead when the flag is true and accepting otherwise.
